item.title: Bernard Grech accuses Abela of lying over private talks

item.description: Momentum was born a year ago and despite surveys showing it still lags far behind the major parties, its chairperson Arnold Cassola believes the fledgling party is on the right track. He tells Karl Azzopardi how he wants to shake up the country’s political landscape.
